title: Jingyu scene description v1
description: A declarative scene: generator calls for geometry and materials, plus lights, cameras and render settings. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees, Z up, colours as sRGB hex. Objects stand on their origin.

intent.description: One sentence: what the picture must make a viewer see or feel. Reviews judge the render against it; never affects rendering.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that describe the picture as intended, e.g. frame.underexposed for a deliberately dark image; they are no longer reported. Prefer fixing the scene.

world.description: The light around the scene. Without environment it is a uniform color at strength; with one, the environment family decides and color and strength are ignored.

then.title: box
then.description: Axis-aligned box standing on its origin.

op.description: Axis-aligned box standing on its origin.

size.description: Width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

then.title: plane
then.description: Flat rectangle in the XY plane, centred on its origin, facing +Z.

op.description: Flat rectangle in the XY plane, centred on its origin, facing +Z.

then.title: sphere
then.description: UV sphere resting on its origin (its lowest point).

op.description: UV sphere resting on its origin (its lowest point).

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

rings.description: Number of rings from pole to pole.

then.title: cylinder
then.description: Closed cylinder standing on its origin.

op.description: Closed cylinder standing on its origin.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

then.title: cone
then.description: Cone or truncated cone standing on its origin.

op.description: Cone or truncated cone standing on its origin.

top_radius.description: Top radius in metres; 0 makes a point.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

then.title: lathe
then.description: Revolve an (r, z) profile around the Z axis. thickness 0 makes a solid; thickness > 0 makes an open-topped shell with a closed floor.

op.description: Revolve an (r, z) profile around the Z axis. thickness 0 makes a solid; thickness > 0 makes an open-topped shell with a closed floor.

profile.description: Points [r, z] in metres from the bottom outer edge upward. r >= 0. A solid is closed to the axis automatically at both ends.

thickness.description: Wall thickness in metres; 0 for a solid.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

sharp_angle.description: Profile corners turning more than this many degrees are shaded crisply.

then.title: vessel
then.description: Parametric vessel family (cup, bowl, vase, bottle, jar, pot): a lathe whose outer wall passes smoothly through base, belly, neck and lip rings.

op.description: Parametric vessel family (cup, bowl, vase, bottle, jar, pot): a lathe whose outer wall passes smoothly through base, belly, neck and lip rings.

belly_at.description: Height of the belly as a fraction of the height.

neck_at.description: Height of the neck as a fraction of the height.

thickness.description: Wall and floor thickness in metres (open vessels only).

open.description: true: hollow with an open top; false: a closed solid.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis.

profile_samples.description: Number of points sampled along the wall.

sharp_angle.description: Profile corners turning more than this many degrees are shaded crisply.

then.title: wall
then.description: Upright slab standing on its origin, spanning x, with rectangular openings cut through it (windows, doors). Light passes through the openings.

op.description: Upright slab standing on its origin, spanning x, with rectangular openings cut through it (windows, doors). Light passes through the openings.

size.description: Width (x), thickness (y) and height (z) in metres.

x.description: Centre of the opening along the wall (x), metres.

sill.description: Height of the opening's bottom edge above the wall base; 0 = door.

openings.description: Rectangular holes through the wall; x is measured from its centre.

then.title: ceramic
then.description: Fired clay: matte bisque (gloss 0) to a glassy glaze (gloss 1).

family.description: Fired clay: matte bisque (gloss 0) to a glassy glaze (gloss 1).

color.description: Body or glaze colour. sRGB hex #rrggbb.

gloss.description: Glaze gloss from matte (0) to mirror-like (1).

then.title: glass
then.description: Transparent refractive glass, clear or tinted, polished or frosted.

family.description: Transparent refractive glass, clear or tinted, polished or frosted.

tint.description: Transmitted colour; white is clear. sRGB hex #rrggbb.

frost.description: Surface frosting from polished (0) to heavily frosted (1).

then.title: metal
then.description: Conductive metal with measured reflectance, from brushed-dull to mirror-polished.

family.description: Conductive metal with measured reflectance, from brushed-dull to mirror-polished.

metal.description: Which metal; sets the physically measured reflectance colour.

then.title: plastic
then.description: Opaque dielectric such as plastic, paint or plaster, matte to glossy.

family.description: Opaque dielectric such as plastic, paint or plaster, matte to glossy.

then.title: principled
then.description: Direct physically based parameters; the escape hatch when no family fits.

family.description: Direct physically based parameters; the escape hatch when no family fits.

coat_weight.description: Strength of a clear coat layer.

group.description: An invisible transform that objects, lights, cameras and other groups can belong to (parent); moving the group moves everything in it.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that are intended for every object in this group, at any depth, e.g. frame.not_visible for the hidden legs and underside of a table.

location.description: Position of the group's origin in metres.

scale.description: Uniform scale factor applied to everything in the group.

material.description: Id of an entry in materials; omitted means neutral grey.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that are intended for this object only, e.g. frame.not_visible for a wall or ceiling that closes the room out of sight.

attached_to.description: Ids of objects this one is fixed to on purpose: walls meeting at a corner, a lamp hanging from a ceiling, a nail in a wall. Sinking into them and hovering are then not reported.

rest_on.description: Id of an object to rest on. The object keeps its x and y, and its height (location z) is computed so its lowest points touch the top surface of that object: a table top, the inside of a bowl.

location.description: Position of the object's origin in metres.

visible.description: false keeps the object in the scene but out of the render.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

radius.description: Size of the emitting sphere in metres; larger is softer.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

radius.description: Size of the emitting sphere in metres; larger is softer.

blend.description: Edge softness of the cone, 0 to 1.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

size.description: Width of the emitter in metres (and its depth unless size_y is given).

size_y.description: Depth of a rectangular emitter in metres, e.g. a window-shaped soft light; omitted means square.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

angle.description: Apparent angular diameter in degrees; larger is softer.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

parent.description: Id of a group this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to the group, and it moves with the group.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

shift.description: Lens shift [x, y] as a fraction of the frame; keeps verticals straight.

camera.description: Id of the camera to render through.

resolution.description: Image width and height in pixels.

engine.description: cycles: path traced; eevee: real-time (needs a GPU); workbench: preview shading.

device.description: Cycles device; auto uses a GPU when one is usable.

view_transform.description: Tone mapping from scene light to display.

transparent_background.description: Render the world background as transparent.

then.title: uniform
then.description: The same colour from every direction: a neutral studio or a plain backdrop.

family.description: The same colour from every direction: a neutral studio or a plain backdrop.

color.description: Colour of the surrounding light and background. sRGB hex #rrggbb.

then.title: daylight
then.description: Outdoor daylight from dawn to dusk, clear to overcast: a physical sky plus a sun whose direction, colour and softness agree with each other. Light through windows and doors comes from here too.

family.description: Outdoor daylight from dawn to dusk, clear to overcast: a physical sky plus a sun whose direction, colour and softness agree with each other. Light through windows and doors comes from here too.

sun_elevation.description: Sun height above the horizon in degrees. 2-10 early morning or late afternoon (long warm light), 25-45 mid-morning, 60+ midday; 0 to -6 is twilight with no direct sun.

sun_azimuth.description: Direction toward the sun in degrees, counter-clockwise from +X seen from above (0 = +X, 90 = +Y, 180 = -X, 270 = -Y). Shadows point the other way.

cloud_cover.description: 0 clear sky with crisp shadows, 0.5 broken clouds, 1 overcast with no direct sun and soft, even light.

haze.description: Aerosols in the air, 0 crystal clear to 10 very hazy; more haze gives a paler sky.

sun_strength.description: Irradiance of the clear-sky sun in W/m^2 (Blender sun strength); clouds and a low sun reduce it automatically.

sun_angle.description: Apparent diameter of the clear-sky sun in degrees; clouds widen it.

sun_temperature_k.description: Sun colour temperature in kelvin; 0 means automatic, following the elevation (about 2600 K at 5 degrees, 5600 K at 60) and the clouds.

ground_color.description: Colour of the land below the horizon, seen through windows and reflected in glossy things (grass, earth, pavement, snow). sRGB hex #rrggbb.

sky_strength.description: Multiplier for light from the sky (blue fill in shadows).
